algorithms.label: SA-SETS
algorithms.name: sa_sets
algorithms.parameter_basis: Project 2023 thesis: 8 searchers, 4 regions, 2 goods per region; mu is retained from the existing SA-SETS implementation. SensorEncodingV3 uses V2 coverage selection and redundancy removal, but a routing-rejected sensor remains scheduled with next_hop=-1 and the chromosome is not modified.

algorithms.label: SI-SETS (Elitist Role-separated Update)
algorithms.name: si_sets
algorithms.parameter_basis: Selective-Investment SETS (formerly SI_SETSv2): each searcher trades only with the goods of its selected region; identity-sensor regions, initialization, crossover and mutation are shared with SA-SETS. RL-SETSv4 market-update ablation without reinforcement learning. Every searcher-good pair produces two crossover children and mutates each with probability mu. Searchers accept only their best improving child1; every visited good accepts the best visiting child2 only when it improves the old good.

algorithms.encoding: N sensing levels + N routing-priority ranks
algorithms.label: Ring-SETS (Shared-Pool Ring-Segment Operator Selection)
algorithms.name: ring_sets
algorithms.parameter_basis: Goods are a single shared pool (no per-region partition), while each searcher picks one of h ring segments to constrain that visit's sensor-pair crossover/mutation span (80% within-segment, 20% segment-plus-adjacent-fragment). Crossover retains both role-preserving children: child1 elitistically updates only its searcher and child2 elitistically updates only its good. A segment's score is purely its recent child1 payoff for the visiting searcher -- there is no goods-pool quality or market-share term, since goods are not partitioned by segment.

algorithms.encoding: N activation priorities + N routing priorities (C4)
algorithms.label: Ring-SETSpriority (Ring-SETS + C4 PriorityEncoding)
algorithms.name: ring_setspriority
algorithms.parameter_basis: Same market, regions and operators as ring_sets; only the chromosome changes to PriorityEncoding C4 (cost-based activation order + energy-based routing order, 2N priority genes). Sensing levels are chosen greedily by the decoder.
